study type: Mixed methods (in-depth interviews followed by cross-sectional survey)
exposure: Health worker motivation (general and specific to immunization)
cohort: The participants were 94 primary healthcare facility managers from Kakamega County in western Kenya.
finding: Primary healthcare facility managers in Kenya identified increasing staff, financial incentives, and meaningful supervisory visits with actionable feedback as key strategies to enhance immunization program effectiveness.
cross-section timing: At the time of the study (single point in time)
